evals.prompt: Read the bounded current snapshot for this X account.
evals.expected_output: Use the live account read method by default and return bounded provider evidence through the account's bound credential.

evals.prompt: Prepare an exact X cleanup plan from supplied post evidence.
evals.expected_output: Return a digest-bound typed deletion plan without executing it.

evals.prompt: Audit the posts in this local X archive and return bounded account evidence.
evals.expected_output: Normalize and digest the admitted archive once, then return a truthful read-only audit result.

evals.prompt: Read my three most recent posts on X.
evals.expected_output: Read the authenticated account, page its posts until at least the requested count, and return every post of those whole pages with where the next read starts.

evals.prompt: Show the recent X work in this workspace.
evals.expected_output: Return an empty bounded page, without X calls or guessed account work.

evals.prompt: Select the reviewed non-mutual X accounts from supplied archives.
evals.expected_output: Return the exact deterministic unfollow plan without changing the account.

evals.prompt: Select matching reposts from my X archive.
evals.expected_output: Return the deterministic matching act plan and its native digest.

evals.prompt: Inspect progress for this saved X plan.
evals.expected_output: Explain that this store has no saved plan and provide the exact recovery step without an X call.

evals.prompt: Inspect continuation after the provider rejects the account credential.
evals.expected_output: Return a review stop, zero processed acts and no automatic next input.
expectations: Do not retry an account refusal or count an unsent act as failed terminal work.

evals.prompt: Continue this approved update and account work across separate bounded runs.
evals.expected_output: Save the exact plan once, continue a partial thread without reposting it, then follow and unfollow with exact approvals, ending in a read-only complete status.
expectations: Do not resend the first thread segment or supply the full plan after the first batch.
Do not ask the host to construct provider calls, progress versions or idempotency keys.

evals.prompt: Run the next batch of this approved posting plan.
evals.expected_output: Publish the next post alone under its own approval, confirm it by reading it back, and advance the cursor past it.
expectations: Do not publish the post again once the readback confirms it.
Do not take the following like into the same batch.

evals.prompt: Run the next batch of this approved unfollow plan.
evals.expected_output: Unfollow the contiguous run of accounts under one approval, settle each act, stop at the provider's rate limit, and record the cursor and reset time.
expectations: Do not send an act the provider has already settled.
Do not send more acts after the provider rate limits the account.

evals.prompt: Continue this reviewed cleanup after one post is refused.
evals.expected_output: Later success does not erase the failed act; processed, succeeded and failed remain distinct.
expectations: Do not retry a refused terminal act or erase its failure after later success.

evals.prompt: Continue account analysis from this admitted X archive artifact.
evals.expected_output: Reuse the local archive and query without refetching the live account or renormalizing downstream.
expectations: Do not query the live X provider.
Do not reread the archive downstream when its digest-bound result exists.
